litigation.mdlName: In re: Exactech Polyethylene Orthopedic Products Liability Litigation
litigation.court: U.S. District Court, Eastern District of New York

phase: Active MDL count; bankruptcy settlement-trust and claims administration
phaseDetail: JPML continues to list MDL-3044 before Senior Judge Nicholas G. Garaufis. Exactech's Chapter 11 plan was confirmed in September 2025 and created a Settlement Trust, so claim status and recovery questions depend on the confirmed plan, trust procedures, deadlines, and the individual claim record rather than an ordinary MDL-wide payout schedule.

settlements.label: Bankruptcy plan and Settlement Trust govern claim administration
settlements.detail: The September 2025 confirmation order approved a Chapter 11 plan that created a Settlement Trust and transferred specified rights and responsibilities to post-confirmation trusts. That process is not a verified universal payment amount for every recalled-device claim.
settlements.individualClaims: Eligibility, allowed-claim status, deadlines, valuation, insurance recovery, and distributions require review of the confirmed plan and trust procedures.
settlements.source: U.S. Bankruptcy Court confirmation order, Case 24-12441

keyDates.label: MDL-3044 established
keyDates.detail: JPML centralized federal Exactech polyethylene orthopedic product cases in the Eastern District of New York before Judge Nicholas G. Garaufis.

keyDates.label: Exactech filed Chapter 11 cases
keyDates.detail: Exactech and affiliates filed bankruptcy proceedings in the District of Delaware, Case 24-12441, affecting personal-injury litigation and claim administration.
keyDates.source: U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the District of Delaware

keyDates.label: Chapter 11 plan confirmed
keyDates.detail: The bankruptcy court entered a confirmation order establishing post-confirmation trusts, including a Settlement Trust, and a framework for claim administration.

keyDates.label: 1,838 actions pending
keyDates.detail: JPML reports 1,838 pending actions and 1,847 historical actions in MDL-3044.

updates.summary: The MDL remains listed by JPML while claim status and potential recovery are governed by the confirmed bankruptcy plan and post-confirmation trust administration.
JPML reports 1,838 pending actions and 1,847 historical actions, unchanged from August 3.
The bankruptcy court confirmed a Chapter 11 plan establishing a Settlement Trust and other post-confirmation claim-administration structures.
